{{Quote|I'm Ismar Brengle, one of Lord Grathan's "indentured" scientists. I'd like to make your destruction of this place highly profitable.|Ismar Brengle|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Ismar Brengle''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who worked for the rebellious [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Grathan]] against her will on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]] capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].

==Biography==
In [[3646 BBY]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Brengle was tricked into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Grathan]] with the promise of exciting research projects. Although initially delighted, she soon came to realize she had been tricked into working for him. In an attempt to seek revenge against Lord Grathan, Brengle wanted to steal plans for advanced [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] limbs, created by another of Lord Grathan's scientists, [[Lanniter Droge]], which she hoped to sell to a contact for a large fee.<ref name="SWTOR" />

In [[3643 BBY]], Brengle met an Imperial individual who was attacking [[Lord Grathan's estate]]. Pleased to see the destruction of her captor's property, Brengle asked the individual to download the cybernetic's data from Lord Grathan's main computer. Having shut down three separate terminals to allow themselves access the main computer, the spacer was able to download everything. Brengle was very excited and promised to pay the spacer for there help. The spacer later received a substantial reward for their help.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' Ismar was voiced by [[Lydia Leonard]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
